**D.** General Assembly resolutions are not formally binding and are not treaties, so A and B are wrong. They are not always declaratory of custom, so C is wrong, and the team note is also wrong: a resolution does not automatically codify custom or prove it conclusively. Whether one reflects custom depends on its content, the voting pattern, and the States' opinio juris, so it is only evidence of custom or a material source.

CONFIDENCE: 90
